about_the_game:
Venture into a calm, immersive journey across strange new worlds.

This is not your typical high-octane action game. Instead, it's a unique, physics-driven experience designed for adult players who enjoy taking their time, exploring at their own pace, and getting lost in procedurally generated and handcrafted environments.

Built by a solo developer from the ground up—including its custom engine—this game offers:

  • Planetary Landing and Exploration: Land on planets, walk their surfaces, and feel the terrain through realistic, physics-based animation.

  • Interactive Physics Systems: Enjoy dynamic cloth and soft-body physics and nuanced character interactions that bring life to the world in subtle ways.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Meet memorable characters and uncover small stories that evoke the spirit of classic sci-fi, inspired by the more contemplative moments of Star Trek.

  • Slow-Paced Gameplay: Relax, solve light puzzles, take in the view, and experience a world that doesn't rush you.

  • A Personal Project: This is a labor of love. It's not built in Unreal or by a big studio—just one person driven by passion. Don’t expect cutting-edge graphics or AAA-level animation. This is a small, indie project with a focus on atmosphere, physics, and creativity—not visual spectacle.

This game is free to play. If players enjoy it, there may be an extended add-on in the future. It's not for everyone—but if you’re looking for something different, something calm and thoughtful with a touch of sci-fi nostalgia, this might be exactly what you’ve been waiting for.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel i7, AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060, AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
